skeleton.$description: Skeleton placeholder (Spinner family). The shimmer sweep itself lives in src/styles/index.css; this is the resting block it sweeps over.

background.$description: A translucent foreground tint rather than an opaque fill, so a placeholder reads the same on canvas, card, popover and sunken surfaces: 1.23:1 in light and 1.27-1.33:1 in dark. The muted fill it replaces measured 1.03:1 on the light canvas and 1.07:1 on a dark card, so dark placeholders all but disappeared.
